# UX & Privacy Checklist: In-page Agent Plan Review

**Purpose**: Review the completeness and precision of Plan Agent interaction, consent, responsive, cancellation, and Google privacy requirements.
**Created**: 2026-08-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are wake-control exposure requirements defined for local-plan, Google-only, empty, and editor-open states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are issue-priority and one-item-per-plan rules specified so overlap and vague-title findings cannot create competing annotations? [Gap, Spec §FR-003–FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are discussion, proposal-preview, keep-original, update, completion, and restart states all defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are cancellation requirements complete for date, Diary/Plan mode, Calendar, Search, Settings, editor, account, navigation, and page lifecycle transitions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is “compact annotation” constrained by placement, non-obstruction, action count, and mobile stacking requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the exact distinction between chat-only state and an actionable proposal explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005–FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Are valid title and time proposal fields, ranges, pair rules, and unchanged-field behavior unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006–FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the current absence of untimed local plans documented so “missing useful time placement” does not cause invented behavior? [Assumption, Spec §FR-003]

## Privacy and Trust Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are the minimum local plan and Google conflict fields enumerated, with all identifiers, credentials, and nonessential calendar fields explicitly excluded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 Are Google read-only context requirements consistent across product admission, functional requirements, edge cases, and update validation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK011 Is explicit confirmation required consistently for title and time updates in every scenario and success criterion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005–FR-007, SC-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Are offline fallback and remote failure requirements consistent with normal Plan availability and account isolation? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, NR-002]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can the 2-second fallback target be measured from wake activation to anchored issue or complete state? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK014 Can zero-write claims be objectively established for chat, keep-original, invalid, cross-date, unknown-ID, and Google-target proposals? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002–SC-003]
- [ ] CHK015 Are responsive acceptance dimensions measurable for 44px targets, overflow, rail geometry, action-dock overlap, and action orientation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK016 Are subjective visual requirements separated from automated geometry evidence and assigned to manual review? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004–SC-005]

## Scenario and Edge Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are concurrent changes to the active plan during a transient session addressed by revalidation or cancellation requirements? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Are stale revision/write failure recovery requirements explicit about retaining source data and preventing silent retry overwrite? [Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are keyboard focus, live status, escape/close behavior, and reduced-motion requirements defined for every Agent state? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Is removability defined without migration, backup cleanup, or changes to Diary Agent behavior? [Coverage, Spec §Product Admission]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
